media.title: Nicholas Brodszky — portrait in Délibáb, 1928
media.altText: Sepia-toned head-and-shoulders portrait of the young Nicholas Brodszky in formal evening dress.
media.publicCaption: Nicholas Brodszky, printed as Bródszky Miklós, in Délibáb on 10 November 1928. The portrait accompanied an interview about his work for Budapest’s Városi Színház.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; Délibáb, 2nd year, no. 45 (10 November 1928), p. 29; Electronic Periodicals Archive, National Széchényi Library.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The source does not identify the photographer; the anonymous photograph was published in Hungary in 1928, and the applicable 70-year term has expired. It is also public domain in the United States because it was published before 1931. The local file is a reduced-resolution crop of the digitized periodical page.
